meta.title: Evaluate app shell model compliance
meta.body_summary: Implement comprehensive PWA optimizations: critical CSS inlining, CacheFirst caching strategy with versioning, background sync, and improved install prompt with offline page.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added PWA optimizations with caching strategies; cursor bot flagged bugs in PWA install detection and sync queue, but PR merged in 2 minutes without human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2194 changed lines across 12 files, this is a large edit by absolute volume, concentrated in service worker, caching, and new composer modules. It fits a broad incremental PWA performance refactor that merged extremely quickly despite bot-flagged bugs, consistent with a fast-tracked feature PR.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot review reported two bugs: 1) 'BeforeInstallPromptEvent' in window check always fails due to incorrect type detection; 2) Sync queue uses 'badge' objectStore, causing data corruption, and IndexedDB transactions are not awaited, leading to race conditions.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved PWA performance via critical CSS inline, CacheFirst caching strategy with versioning, background sync for offline requests, and install prompt.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor generated code with flawed 'BeforeInstallPromptEvent' check and improper IndexedDB usage; bot review caught these, suggesting agent struggles with accurate browser API compatibility detection and transaction safety.

detection_detail.code_reading: Cursor bot performed static analysis and flagged two bugs: incorrect PWA install detection and IndexedDB misuse.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics or benchmarks; PR body only describes intended optimizations.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Post-merge bot review pointed out bugs; no fix was applied before merge, and no follow-up commit observed.

core_change_summary.description: Added PWA optimizations: service worker with CacheFirst strategy, versioned cache cleanup, background sync, critical CSS inline via Vite plugin, offline page, and PWA install prompt composable. Also added documentation files later removed.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Docs were added then removed; loader.css removed; offline page and install prompt components are new UI elements supporting PWA experience.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added caching strategy docs, offline page, and Vite configuration changes.
Main implementation: Extensive service-worker.ts rewrite for CacheFirst, background sync, critical CSS inline; added PWA install composable and prompt component; removed old loader.css.
Documentation cleanup: removed PWA documentation files before merge.

review_signals.summary: Flagged two bugs: incorrect PWA install detection (window.BeforeInstallPromptEvent check) and sync queue data corruption/race conditions in IndexedDB usage.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR with 3 commits implementing PWA optimizations.
PR merged within 2 minutes by maintainer with no human review.
Cursor bot posted a post-merge review flagging two bugs in JavaScript code.
